_doc: Per-project mapping into the local Google Drive for Desktop mount. The dashboard COPIES the finalized DCR PDF into <root>\Daily Reports — Drive for Desktop syncs from there. No Google API tokens needed. Edit this file (and restart the server) when adding a new project or correcting a path. If 'root' is unset or doesn't exist on disk, the archive step WARNs and skips (finalize still succeeds; local PDF is the source of truth).

FR-BX-001._note: Set 'root' to the absolute path of 890's project folder as it appears in File Explorer once Google Drive for Desktop is installed and signed in (e.g. 'G:\\My Drive\\Projects\\890 E 135th Street'). Until then, the archive step warns + skips.
